newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ to announce alliance with major airline.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ to announce alliance with major airline.

text.p: Air New Zealand said on Tuesday it would make an announcement at 12.30 p.m. (2330 GMT) about a commercial alliance with a major overseas airline.
Sources close to Air NZ said the alliance is likely to be with United Airlines.
Air NZ chairman Bob Matthew said last week that Air NZ, which owns half of Ansett Australia, was seeking alliances with major airlines in North America, Europe and Asia.
He said then that Air NZ was on the verge of signing the first of what could be several major alliance deals.
